verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const S='scripts/check-cache-budget.mjs';if(!fs.existsSync(S))process.exit(79);const src=fs.readFileSync(S,'utf8');const bad=[];const m=/const\s+PACKED_PER_RAW\s*=\s*([0-9.]+)/.exec(src);if(!m)bad.push('PACKED_PER_RAW is gone, so nothing converts raw bytes into the units Vercel weighs');if(m&&(parseFloat(m[1])<0.54||parseFloat(m[1])>0.56))bad.push('PACKED_PER_RAW is '+m[1]+', outside the 0.54-0.56 band that the 2026-09-29 production pair put it in (HYG-136, ADR-1638)');if(!/mib\(nodeModules\)/.test(src)||!/mib\(nextCache\)/.test(src))bad.push('the composition line no longer prints node_modules and .next/cache separately, so the ratio can no longer be re-derived from a build log');if(!/Uploading build cache/.test(src))bad.push('the gate no longer tells the reader to compare its estimate against the build own upload line, which is the only way this constant gets re-checked');if(bad.length){console.error(bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)};process.exit(0)"
verify.note: Measures the CONSEQUENCE: that the constant stays inside the band the 2026-09-29 production pair established (HYG-136, ADR-1638), and that the two things which make it RE-DERIVABLE survive — the composition line printing node_modules and .next/cache separately, and the printed instruction to compare the estimate against the build's own upload line. Losing either leaves a number nobody can check, which is how it drifted into being suspected in the first place. The band is deliberately two-sided: raising it hides growth, and lowering it toward the empty-cache ratio of 0.264 applies a ratio measured on one mix to another, the exact error this row was filed about. The first draft of this probe matched the composition line with a `${...}` pattern and failed for a reason that had nothing to do with the file: probes run through a shell, which expanded the parameter reference away before node saw it. It matches the interpolated calls instead. Re-pointed from 0.52-0.54 when the constant moved to 0.55.

append.detail: 2026-09-29 (HYG-136, ADR-1638): the probe band moved from 0.52-0.54 to 0.54-0.56 when PACKED_PER_RAW was re-derived to 0.55 from the production pair that under-read (estimate 1.38 GB, upload 1.42 GB). The row stays done; only the band it ratchets changed.
